# Ginger

deceased

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P36](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0036), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>

## Appearance

Ginger is a bird who features green and gold plumage. When sitting moodily on his perch, he can ruffle his feathers until he resembles a ball.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P36](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0036)_

## Personality

Ginger is a bird widely regarded as unholy, known particularly for his persistent swearing and profane habits of speech. Despite objections from some people, he cannot be broken of his tendency to use foul language.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P38](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0038), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)_
